sampling.method: op2 dense video_frames: ffmpeg accurate seek, one full-resolution PNG per requested timestamp, 7 frames from 0 to 12.0s every 2s

pixel_observations.description: Portrait-format (202x360) clip: a blue-tinted ultrasound sector image occupies the upper half (apical four-chamber-like view, depth ticks along the left edge, a thin cyan baseline strip below it), with a black lower half and a white 'vimeo' watermark at bottom right. In the seven 2-second samples the chamber walls and valve/leaflet echoes change position from sample to sample (a beating-heart loop). No readable measurements, patient name, ID, date or face visible; the image is small and low resolution.

author_context.subject: patient

evidence.quote: Transthoracic echocardiogram (apical 4-chamber view) demonstrating severe global hypokinesia and marked left ventricular systolic dysfunction.
Transthoracic echocardiography (Day 1) revealed severe left ventricular (LV) systolic dysfunction with an ejection fraction of 28%

author_context.rationale: Video 1 caption and the Day 1 echocardiography sentence tie the clip to the case patient's transthoracic echo; hypokinesia, dysfunction and EF come from the text, not the pixels.

limitations: Sampled frames only; intervening frames and continuous motion were not viewed.

Only the PMC '-pmcvs_normal' transcode (202x360, 12.05 s, with an AAC audio track) could be sampled: the original MP4 failed accurate-seek decoding at 12.0 s in op2 dense video_frames. Frames sampled every 2 s from 0 to 12 s (7 frames).
Wall motion and systolic function are not assessed from the frames; the caption's findings are not confirmed or extended by the pixels.

inspection_provenance.frames_viewed_note: All 7 PNG frames viewed at full resolution (small, low-resolution frames).
